question: In 1989 the _______ recommended constitutional recognition for the local government bodies.
solution:
The correct answer is __**PK Thungon Committee**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **PK Thungon Committee** recommended constitutional recognition for local government bodies in 1989.
 
• This recommendation played a crucial role in the eventual passing of the **73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendments** in 1992, which aimed to strengthen and recognize the role of local self-governments in India.
 
• The 73rd Amendment relates to the establishment and empowerment of **Panchayats** (rural local governments), while the 74th Amendment focuses on **Municipalities** (urban local governments).
 
• These amendments introduced provisions for regular elections, reservations for marginalized sections, and greater financial autonomy for local bodies.
 
• The reforms were essential to promote decentralized governance and ensure effective participation of people at the grassroots level in the democratic process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendments** were enacted during the tenure of Prime Minister **P. V. Narasimha Rao**.
 
• These amendments added **Part IX** and **Part IXA** to the Constitution, which specifically deal with Panchayats and Municipalities, respectively.
 
• They also introduced **Schedules XI and XII**, which enumerate the powers, authority, and responsibilities of Panchayats and Municipalities.
 
• The objective was to create a more inclusive and participatory form of governance by involving local communities in decision-making processes.
 
• These amendments have been instrumental in promoting **decentralization**, **accountability**, and **transparency** in local governance.
